walkthroughs.body_html:
There are dozens of feelings beyond happy and sad:

  • Excited, proud, grateful.
  • Nervous, frustrated, jealous.
  • Embarrassed, awkward, content.

Naming helps you handle them. 📝

Anxiety is a worried, on-edge feeling.

Body signs: racing heart, butterflies, sweaty palms.

A little anxiety helps you prepare. A lot can hurt — talk to someone.

Emotional intelligence (EQ) is:

  • Noticing your feelings.
  • Noticing others'.
  • Using that to choose better actions.

People with high EQ make better friends and leaders. 🤝

mcqs.q: What is the behaviourist view on the nature-nurture debate?
options: Strongly nurture - we are shaped by environmental conditioning.

mcqs.q: What does a correlation of -0.8 indicate?
options: A weak relationship (because it is negative).

mcqs.q: Asch's line study primarily demonstrates which type of conformity?
options: Informational social influence (believing others know better).
Normative social influence (compliance to fit in).
